§6PVC§f

§aCadmium-based plastic alternative  -  no BTX required, just unsaturated hydrocarbons and chlorine!§f

PVC (Polyvinylchloride) is an alternative to Hard Plastic made in the §bChemical Plant§f. Recipe: §e250mB§f Unsaturated Hydrocarbons + §e250mB§f Chlorine Gas + Cadmium Powder yields §e2×§f PVC Bar. Needs the Polyvinylchloride Synthesis template.

§6Vs Hard Plastic§f:
§b•§f Uses 50% less Unsaturated Hydrocarbons and Chlorine per bar.
§b•§f Produces 2x output per batch.
§b•§f But requires Cadmium instead of BTX.

§6Uses§f:
§b•§f Replaces Hard Plastic in many machine and component recipes.
§b•§f Used directly in the Pyrolysis Oven recipe.

§ePS:§f Pick PVC when you have Cadmium but limited BTX. Pick Hard Plastic when Cadmium is scarce. Both plastics are useful in different scenarios!
